title: “Grillz on a hijabi”: Intersectional Identities in Fostering Critical AI Literacy

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of AI-generated fashion images based on youth prompts, observing the model's default tendency to generate White models and the necessity of explicit, iterative prompting to represent diverse skin tones.

Evaluating GenAI outputs for their ability to accurately represent Muslim cultural garments (e.g., hijabs, abayas) and adherence to modesty standards, noting the model's misinterpretation of cultural aesthetics and terms.

Observing gendered assumptions in AI image generation, specifically how the model defaults to male figures for regional cultural terms (e.g., 'Khaleeji') and associates 'no makeup' prompts with masculine facial features.
